text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I do feel like I've improved... But I feel
good
because I learned something
important!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's still a secret for now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But who knows? Maybe something
special will
happen at the Sprinters
Stakes. ♪ You'll just have
to wait and
see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, that's what I like to hear. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! By the way, I heard there's a great
little
gelato place around here no one
knows about.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A fan told me about it in my comments.
I'd really
like to check it out.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I did my best during training, so... why
don't we
sneak off and try it?

She says it's within walking distance, and
we still
have a little bit of time until the
bus leaves, so...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
choice_data_list: Then that calls for a reward!
Then that calls for a reward!

text_block_list.text:
Our hot summer training ends with a
delicious cup
of gelato.
